notes:
Inbound SMB lead via self-serve signup (trial). Very privacy-conscious; primary questions around hosted API data retention and opt-out. Short timeline + fragments below.

- 2026-02-24: trial signup from marketing site, 2 devs + 1 PM on onboarding. Signed up to try hosted API for helpdesk summarization + embeddings for ticket search.
- 2026-02-26: 20m intro demo (Marcus). Showed quickstart, streaming, minimal config. Interested in: low lift integration, cost predictability, token-level cost visibility.
- 2026-03-02: security questionnaire submitted (see drive link). Questions focused on: 
  * Do you store prompts/inputs after a request completes? retention windows?
  * Opt-out or request-level "do not log" flag?
  * Can customer request deletion of stored prompts/logs at dataset-level or account-level? SLA for purge?
  * Where are logs stored (region)? do you support data residency?
  * Who has access internally? audit logs?
- 2026-03-04: quick email from legal: "We need to confirm whether prompts are ever used to train models or shared with vendors."
- 2026-03-10: 30m technical sync with Marcus + infra engineer. Key takeaways:
  * They expect hosted_api but default to public cloud only. No immediate need for VPC/private.
  * Primary ask: ability to disable retention per-tenant or per-request (opt-out header), audit trail of deletes.
  * Concern: default log retention length. They want 7 days or ability to configure down to 0-1 day for sensitive flows.
  * Ask for explicit statement: hosted API does not use customer prompts for model training (they want this in writing).
  * Interested in a "prompt purge" API and a deletion SLA (24-72h).
  * Cost sensitivity: SMB budget; estimate small ARR first year.

Quotes / paraphrases:
- "If our customers can opt-out of retention we can push to production — otherwise legal won't sign off." — PM
- "We need a delete API and proof we don't keep prompts for training." — infra lead

Current status: still discovery. They are evaluating hosted_api as low-friction path; will escalate to procurement if legal sign-off OK. Marcus clarified that Hosted default retention today is 30 days (we explained this and noted enterprise opt-out paths exist); asked for written FAQ + product roadmap note on prompt-deletion API.

Action items (internal):
- Send security-faq-v3 (attached) and SMB pricing deck (drive links above).
- Get clear statement from product/legal on training-data usage for hosted_api (short email).
- SE (Marcus) to prepare tech note: retention options, opt-out header details, deletion SLA expectations, how audit logs surface in console.
- Follow-up call week of 2026-03-15 to close remaining legal Qs.

Linked artifacts: drive://redwood/security-faq-v3 (submitted), drive://redwood/pricing-deck-smb (requested), Fireflies ff_87431b2c (2026-02-26 demo).
